title: Peak Optimization
description: For those who use potato as their personal computer.
body:
### OPTIMIZED

pack for those who are using patato as their pc. for people who want pure performance and
client side customizable. every pvp features can be toggled and can be customized, mods have been choosen carefully and contains minimal bloatware.

### PVP

all the essential mods for minecraft pvp is pre-installed, you can add your own at anytime you want.

### ABOUT VULKAN

I have replaced the mod sodium with vulkan for extra performance over vanilla minecraft. vulkan makes your fps go 4x higher than before, it also has same fucntionality as sodium. its ui is made for people who are migrating from sodium with the help of vulkan extra.

### COMPATIBILITY

It is compatible with most computer and there isnt many conflicting mods that i have added. it is really at your own risk when you add your own mods because vulkan is in its beta stage and isnt complete.


```
vanilla: 580 fps | modpack: 1576-2180 fps
```

> _Performance is our priority!_
